# cb:b555

> Centralize belief-graph I/O through CB.Belief.Store: route the three readers that bypass it - CB.Codepath.Predicates (predicates.ex), CB.Belief.EditPairs (edit_pairs.ex), and the CB.Belief.Adjudication race-guard re-read (adjudication.ex) - through Store.read, so Store becomes the sole place that knows the on-disk layout. Precondition for per-belief storage (cb:b554).
